purpose: Pinned source identities for recovering the completed firmware and Hub work into the canonical firmware repository. Snapshot hashes precede destination path and documentation corrections.

firmware_base.treatment: Existing firmware repository ancestry and root source layout retained.

recovered_firmware_updates.treatment: Firmware snapshot recovered at the repository root; repository integration paths and documentation then updated.

hub_import.treatment: Hub application and bundled catalogue imported; repository integration paths and project-direction documentation then updated.

preserved_firmware_reconstruction.description: Earlier Pico S/Pro C decompiler-export reconstruction, retained with its own analysis and checksums. This is not a Python Zymatic server.

external_zymatic_server_reference.role: Read-only reverse-engineering reference. Existing attributed catalogue artwork retains its source notices.

reference_repository_policy: Read-only. All implementation changes, branches and pull requests belong in the destination repository.
private_data: No API keys, local machine backups, Hub databases or build/dependency caches are imported.
